title: Angola Food Security Outlook June 2026 - January 2027: Likely El Niño-induced dryness to lead to outcomes aligned with Crisis (IPC Phase 3) in southern areas by November
summary_ja: アンゴラの農村部では雨水依存型の小規模農業が主流だが、2026年後半から2027年初頭にかけてエルニーニョの影響による乾燥で危機的状況が予測されている。収穫量の減少と市場への依存度の上昇が農家の経済的圧迫を招いており、畜産物からトウモロコシへの交易条件の悪化が追い打ちをかけている。
summary_en: Rural livelihoods in Angola are dominated by rainfed, smallholder agriculture, currently facing climate-induced dryness. Forecasts suggest a decline in cereal harvests and increased market reliance, leading to potential food insecurity as terms of trade for livestock and agricultural labor opportunities decrease.

bottlenecks.description: エルニーニョ現象に伴う乾燥により、農業生産が不安定化し、食料不安が深刻化している。
bottlenecks.evidence_quote: Likely El Niño-induced dryness to lead to outcomes aligned with Crisis (IPC Phase 3) in southern areas by November

bottlenecks.description: 燃料補助金の撤廃に伴う輸送費の上昇が、市場価格の上昇を招き、貧困層の負担となっている。
bottlenecks.evidence_quote: dropping fuel subsidies led to a spike in transportation inflation in July 2024, transferring to higher food prices for the urban poor.

title: Zambia Food Security Outlook - June 2026 - January 2027: Stressed (IPC Phase 2) expected in the south and west due to below-average harvest
summary_ja: ザンビアでは2026年の記録的なトウモロコシ収穫が農家の所得と食料在庫を改善させた一方、エルニーニョ現象による降雨不足と病害の影響が、特に南部や西部地域の農家の商業的活動や購買力にリスクをもたらしている。農家は市場依存度が高まる収穫期後の端境期において、非食料品への支出に課題を抱える見通しである。
summary_en: Record 2026 maize harvests in Zambia have improved household incomes and food stocks, supporting market-oriented activity. However, recurring weather shocks, such as the ongoing El Niño, and disease outbreaks continue to threaten the purchasing power and agricultural stability of smallholders, particularly as they face the lean season.

bottlenecks.description: エルニーニョ現象による降雨不足や高温が、栽培面積の減少や農業労働機会の喪失を招き、農家の購買力を低下させている。
bottlenecks.evidence_quote: Below-average rainfall and delayed onset of the October 2026 to May 2027 rainy season are most likely. Southern and southwestern Zambia are anticipated to experience below-average rainfall along with above-average temperatures. This is expected to drive reductions in the area planted and agricultural labor opportunities and income

bottlenecks.description: 口蹄疫（FMD）による家畜移動の制限が、農家の購買力を抑制する要因となっている。
bottlenecks.evidence_quote: restrictions on livestock movement due to foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), and declining fishing, are expected to reduce purchasing power for essential non-food goods.

success_factors.description: 有利な気候条件での豊作時には、隣国への輸出を行うことで経済的余剰を生み出している。
success_factors.evidence_quote: In favorable seasons, Zambia produces a surplus and exports to neighboring countries such as the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Malawi.
